description: This file defines an asynchronous function 'callApi' for making HTTP requests with support for retries, caching, and payload handling. It imports external modules and constants, and manages request construction, cache validation, and response processing.

methods.name: tryParsePayload
methods.description: Parses the payload as JSON if it's a string, otherwise returns it directly. Throws an error if parsing fails.

methods.name: getFullUrl
methods.description: Constructs a full URL by appending search parameters to a base URL if provided.

methods.name: callApi
methods.description: Main function to perform an API call with support for retries, caching, and payload formatting. Handles GET, POST, PATCH, PUT methods, manages cache validation with ETags, and processes different payload types.
